figures.caption: Determination of peptide-induced membrane damage of E. coli (ATCC 25922) cells and hRBCs by Chrysophsin-1 and its analogs. figures.caption: Determination of the diffusion potential and estimation of secondary structures of Chrysophsin-1 and its variants in lipid vesicles of different compositions. (B) Shows the percent fluorescence recovery in [PC/PG 3:1 (w/w)]. (C) Represents fluorescence profiles for peptide-induced depolarization of PC/Chol [(8:1(w/w)] vesicles at 15 μM concentration for each of these peptides.
